fields.description:
Discovered while authoring Cloud config-validation coverage for story 2127-348c-c41d-472e.

## Problem
The DC transport rejects a non-https reconciler.base_url: ReconcilerConfig.__post_init__ (src/rebar/_config_schema.py) calls _validate_reconciler_tls, which raises ConfigError for any non-https scheme unless reconciler.allow_insecure is set. Cloud's JiraConfig (the jira.url/user/project dataclass in the same module) has NO __post_init__ and performs NO URL-scheme validation, so a cleartext http:// Jira URL is accepted silently, risking credential (API token / basic-auth) exposure in transit.

Additionally, DC's settings resolver (resolve_jira_datacenter_settings) is deliberately FAIL-LOUD: its docstring explicitly rejects swallowing ConfigError as "against rebar's fail-loud posture". Cloud's resolve_jira_settings (adapters/jira/acli_subprocess.py) instead swallows ConfigError to degrade to env-only on a MALFORMED config. So even after JiraConfig rejects, the rejection would be silently swallowed there unless we let a security-policy rejection propagate.

Pinned as current behaviour by tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_cloud_config_validation.py::test_cloud_jira_config_does_not_reject_non_https_url_absence_documented (absence-documenting).

## Change (parity with the DC ReconcilerConfig validator)
1. In src/rebar/_config_schema.py: introduce InsecureUrlError(ConfigError) and generalize the scheme check into a shared _validate_https_url(url, allow_insecure, *, url_label, override_label) that raises InsecureUrlError (naming the cleartext risk and the override key) or warns when overridden. Keep _validate_reconciler_tls as a thin wrapper delegating with reconciler.* labels (DC messages/behaviour unchanged).
2. Add allow_insecure: bool = False to JiraConfig and a __post_init__ calling _validate_https_url(self.url, self.allow_insecure, url_label="jira.url", override_label="jira.allow_insecure").
3. Register the "allow_insecure" coercer under the "jira" section coercion map.
4. Re-export InsecureUrlError from src/rebar/config.py.
5. Make Cloud parity EFFECTIVE and fail-loud (matching DC): in resolve_jira_settings, let InsecureUrlError propagate (except InsecureUrlError: raise) BEFORE the existing except ConfigError degrade-to-env path, so a deliberate non-https rejection is not silently swallowed while a genuinely malformed config still degrades.

## Test plan (held-out TDD, RED->GREEN mutation checks recorded in the change)
- Flip test_cloud_config_validation.py item 2a from absence-doc to enforcement:
  * JiraConfig(url="http://insecure.example.com", user="u", project="DIG") raises ConfigError matching "not 'https'"; message names cleartext + jira.allow_insecure.
  * JiraConfig(url="http://...", allow_insecure=True) is accepted and emits the "NOT encrypted" warning.
  * JiraConfig() (empty url) and https url are accepted (negative controls).
  * Update the module docstring/table: 2a now IMPLEMENTED by this bug; 2b (missing cred) remains absence-doc tracked by ad85.
- In test_config_jira_wiring.py: add a resolver-level test that a well-formed rebar.toml with jira.url=http://... FAILS LOUD (raises, not env fallback), and with jira.allow_insecure=true resolves. Keep test_malformed_config_falls_back_to_env green (parse error still degrades).
- Mutation check (inverse): removing the JiraConfig __post_init__ flips the enforcement test RED; removing the InsecureUrlError re-raise flips the fail-loud resolver test RED.

## Risk / rollout
No config file or test in the tree sets jira.url to http:// (verified by grep), so no existing passing config breaks. allow_insecure provides the loopback/trusted-network escape hatch, mirroring reconciler.allow_insecure. DC messages/tests are unchanged (thin wrapper).

## Out of scope
- ad85 (missing-credential loud failure) — separate follow-up.
- e34a (configurable resolved-statuses) — separate follow-up.
- Threading allow_insecure into the ACLI transport (validation-only; ACLI carries scheme in the url).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] JiraConfig rejects a non-https url with a ConfigError (InsecureUrlError) naming the cleartext risk and jira.allow_insecure.
- [ ] jira.allow_insecure=true downgrades the rejection to a warning and accepts the url.
- [ ] Empty/unset url and https url are accepted.
- [ ] jira.allow_insecure is wired as a config key (coercion) and InsecureUrlError is re-exported from rebar.config.
- [ ] resolve_jira_settings fails loud on a non-https jira.url (does not degrade to env), while a malformed config still degrades.
- [ ] The absence-doc test is flipped to enforcement and the module docstring updated; DC tests remain green.
- [ ] make lint, make typecheck, and the reconciler unit tests pass.
